## Purpose
Renders the brief-entry screen where a user types (or dictates) an idea/instruction, attaches files or images, composes an agent pipeline, and launches a workflow run. It also carries the intent-based agent-recommendation engine used by the "custom" workflow type and the dispatch-type resolution logic that maps a chosen agent set to a backend `pipeline_type` + deliverable override.

## Shape
- `IdeaInputPage` (default-ish named export, `IdeaInputPageProps`) — the main component: owns the brief textarea, file/image attachment state (`attachedFiles`, `attachedFileContents`, `attachedImages`), speech-to-text via `useSpeechRecognition`, the `pipelineAgents` list, and the `handleRun`/`handleSaveWorkflow` handlers that call `onRun`/`createUserWorkflow`.
- `TYPE_CONFIG` — per-`WorkflowType` static copy (tag/heading/subtitle/placeholder/icon) driving the page's presentation for each pipeline type (user_stories, prototype, od_ppt, migration, custom, etc.).
- `INTENT_MAP` + `getAgentRecommendations()` — intent-based (strong/weak/exclusion signal) matcher that scores a free-text brief against known intents (user_stories, prototype, presentation, market_research, security, testing, …) and returns ranked `AgentDef` suggestions for the "custom" workflow type; exported for reuse by `ComposerPage`.
- `COMPANION_GROUPS` — known multi-agent pipeline groupings (e.g. full Prototype pipeline) used to prompt the user to complete a partially-assembled custom pipeline.
- `AGENT_DELIVERABLE_MAP` + `resolveDispatchType()` — maps a selected agent-id set to a deliverable override (`single_file` HTML, `streamed_text` markdown, etc.) while keeping `pipeline_type` fixed at `"custom"` for all composer-built runs; exported for reuse by `ComposerPage`.
- `MIGRATION_OPTIONS` + migration sub-pipeline picker UI — handles the `"migration"` meta-type, which requires the user to pick a concrete sub-pipeline (Mulesoft→Spring Boot or .NET→Azure) before Run is enabled.
- Renders child components `AgentsPopup` (agent library/model-override/selections popup), `ReviewGatesSection` (per-run human-review gate picker), and `NameWorkflowModal` (save-workflow dialog).

## Why this shape
Inline comments (KAN-112, Phase 21 LAUNCH-EXISTING-PATH, EMP-01, ISS-014) indicate the intent engine, companion-group suggestions, and the various `initial*` seed props were added incrementally to support saved/relaunched workflows and smarter custom-pipeline composition without changing the byte-identical default payload for existing flows — refs (`gateSelectionRef`, `modelOverridesRef`, `selectionsRef`) are used specifically so child-reported state doesn't force page re-renders and so only user-touched fields are included in the run/save payloads.
